h1: Crystal Hotel Hat Yai — A New Design Hotel With a Rooftop Pool Opposite CentralFestival
intro: If you want a clean, newly designed room with a rooftop pool to photograph for around a thousand baht, Crystal Hotel Hat Yai is a pick many reviews single out. It's a contemporary minimalist hotel on Kanchanavanich Road, near CentralFestival Hat Yai, an easy few minutes' walk to the mall and the night market. The 164-room hotel has a rooftop infinity pool, a fitness centre, the Bottega restaurant and even a bowling alley in the building. Rooms start from approx. THB 1,300/night. It scores 8.9 from 555 reviews and ranks #18 of 108 Hat Yai hotels on Tripadvisor — its draw is newness, a smart pool and a location next to the mall.

body.html: What sets Crystal Hotel Hat Yai apart from many city hotels is its newness and design · the rooms are contemporary and minimalist with a clean palette, and several have glass-walled bathrooms and city or mountain views · many reviews praise how clean, fresh and well-kept the rooms feel for the price · the location on Kanchanavanich Road sits near CentralFestival Hat Yai, an easy few-minute walk to the mall and night market, ideal for shoppers and foodies.

There are 164 rooms across several categories, from Deluxe and Smart Deluxe up to Skyline Rooms and the Landmark Suite · entry-level rooms keep things clean and simple with comfortable beds, while higher Skyline rooms give a broader view over Hat Yai · every room has free Wi-Fi and a pillow menu · worth knowing: some reviews say the lower-tier rooms are smaller than the photos suggest and that storage or wardrobe space is limited, so for a multi-night stay pick a slightly larger room.
"Clean, modern-looking room with a comfy bed, and the rooftop pool is lovely — especially at sunset. Check-in was quick and friendly, and the price felt great value."

The star here is the rooftop infinity pool, which looks out over the city and the sunset and is the feature reviews photograph and mention most · beyond the pool there's a fitness centre, the Bottega restaurant, a bar, a bowling alley, karaoke and a beauty salon in the building, giving you more to do on-site than a typical city hotel · breakfast is a buffet included in many packages, and most reviews rate it well even if the spread isn't huge.

Service scores well · many reviews praise the quick, friendly front-desk check-in, and some staff are named for going the extra mile · free parking is a plus for self-drivers · overall it reads as a hotel that feels new and well-looked-after at an accessible price, which is why the overall score reaches 8.9.

There are trade-offs to accept · some reviews mention air conditioning that doesn't perform in certain rooms, a musty smell, and a few sagging mattresses, which points to upkeep that isn't fully consistent room to room · the rooftop pool occasionally closes for weddings or events, disappointing guests who came to swim · and a handful of reviews note missing basics such as an iron or toiletries · if you hit a problem, raise it at the front desk straight away, as most issues get sorted.

Rates start around THB 1,300/night for a Deluxe in regular periods, rising to roughly THB 1,500–2,000 for Super Deluxe and Skyline, with suites higher depending on the season · over long weekends and festivals, when Malaysian and Singaporean visitors pour into Hat Yai, prices climb quickly and rooms sell out fast · a score of 8.9 from 555 reviews and an #18-of-108 Tripadvisor ranking show this is a city design hotel that offers good value and keeps most guests happy.

In short, Crystal Hotel Hat Yai suits travellers who want a new, well-designed room, a rooftop pool to photograph, and a location near CentralFestival for around a thousand baht · it works for couples, groups of friends and families shopping and eating in Hat Yai · but if you prioritise a direct indoor link into a downtown mall, or want the rock-steady, room-to-room consistency of a big chain, compare it against the downtown Hat Yai hotels too.

A tip from the reviews: ask for a Skyline or higher-floor room for the city view and more space · if you're set on swimming, check with the hotel whether the pool is closed for any event on your dates · always book a Free Cancellation rate, and if you get a room with AC or smell issues, ask to switch at check-in · and reserve well ahead over long weekends, as rooms fill fast.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Crystal Hotel Hat Yai

faq.q: Where is Crystal Hotel Hat Yai and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's at 4 Kanchanavanich Road Soi 23 in Hat Yai, Songkhla, near CentralFestival Hat Yai, an easy few-minute walk to the mall and night market · about 5 minutes by car from Songklanagarind Hospital · roughly 10 minutes from Kim Yong Market and about 20 minutes from Hat Yai Airport (HDY).

faq.q: What are the room rates and room types at Crystal Hotel Hat Yai?
faq.a: Rates start around THB 1,300/night for a Deluxe · Super Deluxe at about THB 1,600 · a higher-floor Skyline at about THB 1,900 · and the Landmark Suite from about THB 3,200 · prices depend on season and rise quickly on long weekends, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Crystal Hotel Hat Yai have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes · a rooftop infinity pool looking over the city and sunset, the hotel's standout feature in reviews · note that the pool sometimes closes for weddings or events, so if you're set on swimming, check with the hotel first.

faq.q: Who is Crystal Hotel Hat Yai best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers who want a new, well-designed room, a rooftop pool and a location near CentralFestival for around a thousand baht · great for couples, groups of friends and families shopping and eating in Hat Yai · if you want a direct indoor mall link, also look at the downtown options.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Crystal Hotel Hat Yai?
faq.a: It's a new, smartly designed hotel, but some reviews note underperforming AC, a musty smell, and a few sagging mattresses · lower-tier rooms are fairly small with limited storage · choose Super Deluxe or above, book a Free Cancellation rate, and ask to switch rooms at check-in if you hit a problem.

faq.q: What facilities does Crystal Hotel Hat Yai have?
faq.a: There's a rooftop pool, fitness centre, the Bottega restaurant, a bar, a bowling alley, karaoke and a beauty salon in the building · free breakfast, Wi-Fi and parking · more on-site evening activities than a typical city hotel, good for groups and families.
